details: On May 4, 2026, President Trump ordered a US naval blockade of vessels in the Strait of Hormuz following the collapse of US-Iran peace talks. This escalation of tensions in the critical oil trade chokepoint led to Bitcoin surging past $80,000, triggering over $300 million in short liquidations across the crypto market as traders were caught by surprise.
title: US Naval Blockade in Hormuz Spurs Bitcoin Rally
